_comment: Phase 1 example MCP server config for the StoryNova Narrative OS Agent. Placeholders only - do NOT commit real secrets. Use environment variables.

vector-store.purpose: RAG backbone: past decks, win/loss notes, approved messaging, case studies

web-search.purpose: Live competitor pages, pricing, reviews, news

fetch.purpose: Fetch and read specific competitor/prospect URLs

crm-salesforce.purpose: Real deal context, logged objections, personas, closed-lost reasons

call-intelligence-gong.purpose: Mine real objections + competitor mentions from call transcripts

slides.purpose: Render pitch decks to .pptx / Google Slides

docs.purpose: Publish battle cards and objection guides where reps look

memory.purpose: Persist the canonical narrative spine + versioning

planning.purpose: Structured multi-step reasoning for the orchestrator
